## Pull request overview

This PR aims to unblock CI by updating the `@objectstack/client` test suite to reflect the current client API (specifically, the removal of `client.ai.chat()`), while also refreshing auto-generated API reference docs and the changelog to match recent spec changes.

**Changes:**
- Update client AI tests to stop calling the removed `client.ai.chat()` method and assert it’s not part of the API surface.
- Regenerate/adjust API reference documentation pages and navigation (including a new `core-services` page).
- Add an Unreleased changelog entry describing the CI/test fix.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 8 out of 8 changed files in this pull request and generated 8 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/client/src/client.test.ts | Replaces the obsolete `ai.chat()` test with an assertion that `chat` is not exposed on `client.ai`. |
| content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx | Updates the “Validate data” example to parse `AiInsightsRequest`. |
| content/docs/references/api/plugin-rest-api.mdx | Expands docs to include handler status / coverage schemas and updates import examples. |
| content/docs/references/api/dispatcher.mdx | Adds dispatcher error code/response docs and updates import examples. |
| content/docs/references/api/discovery.mdx | Updates ServiceStatus docs and adds RouteHealthEntry/Report docs and imports. |
| content/docs/references/api/meta.json | Adds `core-services` to API reference navigation. |
| content/docs/references/api/core-services.mdx | New API reference page for “Core Services”. |
| CHANGELOG.md | Adds an Unreleased “Fixed” entry describing the client test update. |
</details>

The TypeScript snippet imports the same symbols twice (value import + `import type` with identical names). In TypeScript this causes duplicate import/identifier issues, and it’s also unnecessary here since `.parse()` requires the runtime Zod schema. Suggest removing the `import type { ... }` line (or consolidating into a single import with `type` modifiers only for names that are type-only exports).

The TypeScript usage example imports the same names twice (runtime import + `import type` with identical identifiers). This won’t compile in TS and is misleading because `.parse()` needs the runtime Zod schema. Keep only the value import (or use a single import with `type` modifiers for type-only exports) to avoid duplicate imports.
```suggestion

```

The TypeScript snippet imports `DispatcherConfig`/`DispatcherErrorCode`/etc twice (normal import + `import type` with the same identifiers). That pattern doesn’t compile and is confusing since `.parse()` requires the runtime schema values. Remove the duplicate `import type` line, or consolidate into a single import using `type` modifiers only where needed.
```suggestion

```

The Service Status bullet list has a wrapped line that’s not indented, so `not been verified (may 501 at runtime).` renders as a separate paragraph instead of part of the `registered` bullet. Indent continuation lines to keep the explanation within the same list item.
```suggestion
  not been verified (may 501 at runtime).
```

The TypeScript usage snippet imports the same identifiers twice (value import + `import type` with identical names). This is invalid TS and is unnecessary because the `.parse()` call needs the runtime Zod schema. Remove the duplicate `import type` line or consolidate into a single import that only marks genuinely type-only exports as `type`.
```suggestion

```

This new page appears to be incorrectly generated/placed: the Source callout points to `packages/spec/src/api/core-services.zod.ts`, but that file doesn’t exist, and there’s already a System-level Core Services reference at `content/docs/references/system/core-services.mdx` sourced from `packages/spec/src/system/core-services.zod.ts`. Consider removing this API page (and its nav entry) or correcting it to reference the actual schema location and exports.
```suggestion
{/* Legacy stub: this page was auto-generated in the wrong location. */}

<Callout type="info">
**Source:** `packages/spec/src/system/core-services.zod.ts`
</Callout>

This API-level reference page has been deprecated in favor of the canonical System Core Services
documentation.

Please see: [`System / Core Services`](../system/core-services)
for the authoritative schema definition and TypeScript usage examples.

---
```

The TypeScript snippet imports `ServiceStatus` twice (normal import + `import type` with the same identifier), which doesn’t compile and is unnecessary because `.parse()` needs the runtime schema value. Remove the `import type` line (or consolidate imports) so the example is valid TypeScript.

`core-services` is added to the API reference nav, but the corresponding page (`references/api/core-services.mdx`) appears to be an erroneous duplicate of the existing System Core Services docs and references a non-existent source file. Recommend removing this entry from the API nav (or relocating/fixing the page under the correct section).
```suggestion

```
